 LIVE UPDATES NBA New York Knicks vs. Boston Celtics Live NBA Updates, Scores and Highlights
 Dan Favale Oct 23, 2026, updated 1 min ago 
 The Boston Celtics and the New York Knicks square off for the first time of the 2026-27 NBA regular season on Friday night with both squads still looking to notch their first win.
 This showdown also marks the first time Mitchell Robinson squares off against his former team, with whom he just won the title a few months ago. On top of that, this is the Celtics' home-opener, making it Paul George's regular-season debut in front of the Boston faithful.
 One of these Eastern Conference powers will leave TD Garden with its first win of the season. The other will incite consternation among its fanbase with a second straight loss to open the year.
 Follow all the action below right along with us as we break down the latest updates, highlights, analysis and takeaways from one of the Association's oldest rivalries.
 Live Updates
 36 Total Posts
 Newest First ​ Just Now 09:42 PM Jayson Tatum Has Ice in His Veins
 Super clutch jumper from Jayson Tatum to put the Celtics up three. 
 Stan Van Gundy made an excellent point on the Prime broadcast, too. The Knicks can't send as many bodies at Tatum if he's operating from the mid-post. They can throw more at him when he's working from the top of the key or the wings.
 Score: Celtics 104, Knicks 98 | 45.0 seconds remaining in the fourth quarter 
 Just Now 09:39 PM Mitchell Robinson Dunked on His Former Team 👀
 Thank you very much to the Celtics' social admin for getting this one up.
 8 mins ago 09:35 PM Boston Missed 9 Straight Shots
 This is where the Celtics feel like they'll miss Jaylen Brown the most: in crunch time.
 Score: Celtics 99, Knicks 96 | 2:05 remaining in the fourth quarter 
 16 mins ago 09:27 PM The Knicks are Down Double Digits, But It's Not All Bad
 This is similar to what happened in the first quarter, but the Knicks weren't able to take advantage. They need more guys breaking the paint on cuts and drives.
 Boston has put Mitchell Robinson back in the game even though he's got five fouls. Another thing to watch.
 Score: Celtics 94, Knicks 84 | 6:53 remaining in the fourth quarter 
 24 mins ago 09:19 PM Mitchell Robinson Rejects KAT 🎥
 Dwyane Wade is right on the call. Mitch should have let KAT know about it. 
 30 mins ago 09:13 PM Neemias Queta for 3?! 
 Neemias Queta has now tied his single-season high for made three-pointers with one. 
 Boston is taking a 10-point lead into the fourth quarter. Jayson Tatum just put on a masterclass in the third with 16 points and three assists. The Celtics defense is everywhere, on top of everyone, all at once. 
 New York's offense is entering nightmare territory. It turned the ball over on 29.2 percent of its third-quarter possessions and has no consistent answers for Boston's ball pressure.
 Score: Celtics 83, Knicks 73 | End of the third quarter 
 38 mins ago 09:05 PM Crazy Deuce McBride Sequence 🎥
 It's only fair that Deuce McBride's three went in after that circus save. 
 39 mins ago 09:04 PM Vintage PG Slam 🎥
 Paul George hasn't shot the ball particularly well tonight. But he's disrupting a bunch of plays at the defensive end, moving without the ball and, now, has this jam under his belt.
 41 mins ago 09:02 PM Bostons Defense is All Over the Place 🎥
 The Celtics have forced turnovers on a whopping 20-plus percent of the Knicks' offensive possessions. Not surprisingly, they have also outscored New York by five points on the break—a not-so-minor detail when they're winning the paint battle by 12 points, too.
 47 mins ago 08:56 PM Anybody Have Eyes on Mikal Bridges' Offense?
 Bridges is playing most well on defense but is now 0-of-6 from the floor in this game. The Knicks can't afford to have him remain scoreless with the Celtics all over Jalen Brunson.
 New York is currently challenging a block foul that was called against Landry Shamet. 
 Score: Celtics 68, Knicks 60 | 4:16 remaining in the third quarter 
 50 mins ago 08:53 PM Jayson Tatum Goes 1-on-5 🎥
 First and foremost, this is absurd fluidity while engaging so many different defenders. 
 Secondly, Tatum attacking the basket in both the half-court and transition has been the third-quarter difference for Boston.
 52 mins ago 08:51 PM Jayson Tatum Corkscrew Layup 🎥
 Three of Tatum's five third-quarter shot attempts have now come in the paint, including this little beauty off a baseline catch-and-drive.
 Score: Celtics 66, Knicks 60 | 5:09 remaining in the third quarter 
 56 mins ago 08:47 PM Jayson Tatum is LOCKED In
 Tatum is walking the walk in addition to talking the talk. He's attacking the basket and getting the Knicks' defense on the move. 
 New York now has 12 turnovers on the evening and is losing the points battle in the paint, on the break and off second-chance opportunities.
 59 mins ago 08:44 PM The Celtics Offense is Perking Up
 Jayson Tatum already has two assists in the third quarter, and the Celtics have come out of the locker room on a 10-5 run.
 Jordan Walsh scored his first two buckets of the season during this stretch. Derrick White hit a wing three off a strong Mitchell Robinson gravity roll. And Tatum hit a trademark middie. Boston is putting New York's defense in rotation pretty consistently, and the reigning champs aren't executing quickly enough at the moment.
 Score: Celtics 60, Knicks 54 | 8:11 remaining in the third quarter 
 1 hour ago 08:29 PM The Knicks' Wings are Having a Rough Time
 Mikal Bridges is the biggest culprit thus far. After shooting 2-of-8 in the season-opener, he is 0-of-4 and has yet to score against the Celtics. 
 OG Anunoby isn't faring too much better. On the heels of his 3-of-12 performance Tuesday night, he's 2-of-5 from the floor.
 New York is built to navigate down games from any one of its wings, but with Brunson yet again struggling (2-of-6), the offense needs one of OG or Bridges to start making shots.
 1 hour ago 08:22 PM PG Gives the Celtics a 1-Point Lead at the Half
 Paul George hit a corner three at the buzzer to put the Celtics up one heading into the locker room. Karl-Anthony Towns leads all scorers with 12 points. Jayson Tatum has 11 for Boston.
 Both squads continue to struggle from downtown. Boston's ball pressure also seems to be grating on New York. 
 Score: Celtics 50, Knicks 49 | HALFTIME 
 1 hour ago 08:15 PM James Wiseman Officially Makes His Knicks Debut
 Mike Brown is either giving Andre Drummond a rest after overworking him on Tuesday night, or he's just pushing another button after the Celtics outscored the Knicks by seven points in AD's first-quarter stint.
 Methinks it's the latter. The Celtics' combination of ball pressure, two mobile bigs and a floor-spacer like Luka Garza isn't a good matchup for Drummond.
 1 hour ago 08:11 PM Two Celtics Legends are in the House
 Both Paul Pierce and Ray Allen were members of the 2008 Celtics championship team, which also holds the title for the championship team that is least likely to let you forget that they were a championship team. 
 1 hour ago 08:06 PM Derrick White Hits the Circus Shot 🎥
 Derrick White clearly thought he was fouled and just flipped the ball up toward the basket. He didn't get the call, but it worked out well for him in the end, wouldn't you say?
 1 hour ago 08:01 PM The Celtics are Keeping Their Fouls in Check
 The Celtics have yet to commit a foul in the second after giving 'em out like Halloween candy in the first. They looked like they might open up a double-digit lead, but a missed layup led to a Landry Shamet transition three that prompted a Joe Mazzulla timeout.
 Now, the Knicks are within two.
 Score: Celtics 41, Knicks 39 | 5:50 remaining in the second quarter 
 1 hour ago 07:51 PM The Tides are Already Turning
 Luka Garza is leaving his mark with Mitchell Robinson and Neemias Queta on the bench. He just drilled a three to put the Celtics up four and already has an offensive rebound and drawn foul through barely three minutes of action.
 Score: Celtics 31, Knicks 27 | 10:33 remaining in the second quarter 
 1 hour ago 07:48 PM The Knicks Take a 1-Point Lead into the Second Quarter
 Both teams are shooting 3-of-11 from three apiece, but the Celtics' offense feels more disjointed overall. They have five offensive rebounds but aren't converting them at a high clip. They've also only churned out one transition play, a pace that will favor the Knicks.
 Foul trouble isn't helping Boston. Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta and Jayson Tatum all enter the second quarter with two personals.
 Deuce McBride and Karl-Anthony Towns are leading the way for New York. They combined for 16 points and all of the Knicks' made threes.
 Score: Knicks 27, Celtics 26 | End of the first quarter 
 2 hours ago 07:42 PM This Joe Mazzulla Stat is WILD 🤯
 It turns out inheriting a ready-made championship contender is a pretty good first-time head-coaching gig. Who knew?!
 Granted, Mazzulla deserves his flowers. Especially for last season. Winning 56 games largely without Jayson Tatum and after the front office moved off a handful of veterans is a big deal.
 2 hours ago 07:37 PM The Celtics Need an Answer for KAT
 KAT has eight points early, including this nifty finish: 
 Even with Queta and Robinson on the roster, Towns' combination of size and mobility at the offensive end continues to stand out. The Celtics better hope their bigs' foul trouble is only temporary. They're probably not built to guard KAT without one of them in the lineup.
 Score: Knicks 24, Celtics 20 | 2:46 remaining in the first quarter 
 2 hours ago 07:30 PM The Celtics' Bigs are in Foul Trouble
 Both Mitchell Robinson and Neemias Queta now have two personals. Joe Mazzulla is leaving Queta in for now rather than downsizing. Look for the Knicks to attack that.
 2 hours ago 07:28 PM Mikal Bridges and Andre Drummond Already Have a Secret Handshake Routine
 Just two multimillionaires having some grade-school fun. 
 2 hours ago 07:27 PM Karl-Anthony Towns Deep Trail 3s are Back, Too
 That's a lot of floor-spacing. It also New York's only made three so far. The team is 1-of-5 from beyond the arc.
 The Celtics had to pull Mitchell Robinson already, before hitting the nine-minute mark, after he picked up two early fouls. Boston has committed five fouls as a squad, which puts the Knicks squarely in the penalty for the rest of the quarter.
 Jalen Brunson is salivating at the thought.
 Score: Knicks 13, Celtics 12 | 6:21 remaining in the first quarter 
 2 hours ago 07:23 PM Jayson Tatum Fadeaway Jumpers are Back
 Who doesn't love a good one-legged fadeaway off a body bump to create separation?
 Score: Celtics 12, Knicks 11 | 6:56 remaining in the first quarter 
 2 hours ago 07:15 PM KAT and Mitch Take the Jump-Ball
 This looks weird in so many ways. In fairness, though, it was probably a common occurrence during practice over the past two years.
 Oh, and we're officially off!
 Score: Celtics 4, Knicks 0 | 10:23 remaining in the first quarter 
 2 hours ago 07:09 PM Jayson Tatum Addresses Celtics Fans
 To quote the great philosopher Jaylen Brown: 🧢.
 (It's actually cool to see Tatum healthy for a home-opener again.)
 2 hours ago 07:01 PM No Changes to the Knicks' Starting 5
 Are you as (not-at-all-)shocked as I am? 
 2 hours ago 06:57 PM Mitchell Robinson Didn't Watch the Knicks' Championship Ceremony Because...
 "I don't have cable" is such a pre-2019 excuse. 
 Hey, @NBA. Can we maybe hook Mitchell Robinson up with a League Pass subscription that comes with a Zoom tutorial on how to download the NBA app onto his phone?
 2 hours ago 06:46 PM Mike Brown is Keeping the Knicks' Mitchell Robinson Plans Close to the Vest
 Way to play it coy, Mike. 
 No matter what the Knicks plan to employ throughout the game, I think we can all agree it'd be hysterical if they fouled Mitchell Robinson immediately after the opening tip. You know, just for the lulz.
 3 hours ago 06:43 PM The Celtics are Rolling with the Same Starting 5
 Some have wondered whether Joe Mazzulla might sub out Jordan Walsh for someone else in the starting five, but he's sticking with the group he favored for much of the preseason.
 Though the offense here could get a little dicey with Robinson's limited range and Jordan Walsh's general lack of aggression, this fivesome notched a net rating of 40.6 during Boston's opening-day loss to the Detroit Pistons.
 3 hours ago 06:40 PM Mike Brown Shuts Down Championship Ring Talk
 For those who might not have heard, Joe Vardon of The Athletic reported that the Knicks didn't have championship rings ready for assistant coaches during the team's banner-raising ceremony on Tuesday. The report also outlined how odd it was that commissioner Adam Silver didn't speak during the celebration.
 Beyond that, New York apparently ran a check on employees by sending a simulated phishing email about selecting a championship ring style. Those who clicked on it were then "forced to attend a mandatory cybersecurity class," per Vardon.
 The Knicks have since admitted the faux-phishing attack was " an unfortunate mistake ." They also said that they "will provide more than 275 rings to 'players, coaches, employees and other members of the Knicks family.'" 
 It comes as no surprise that Mike Brown won't comment on the matter. Both he and team president Leon Rose work for the human weenie that is James Dolan. Ring or no ring, there would likely be hell to pay if Brown divulged any juicy deets.  
 3 hours ago 06:32 PM The Celtics are Already Loving Mitchell Robinson
 Mitchell Robinson fits with the Celtics' focus on crashing the offensive glass, so it's no surprise that Joe Mazzulla digs having him on the roster.
 The big question tonight: Will New York at any point employ Hack-a-Mitch versus its former center?
